## Key facts (retrieved 2026-11-20; sources on the home page)
- 19 Las Vegas tower plats: 475 closings at a $480,000 median, 12 months ending 2026-09-18 (Nevada Real Estate Group, MLS records).
- Tower medians, 12 months to 2026-09-30: Waldorf Astoria $2,906,000; Turnberry Place $744,800; Panorama Towers $552,500; Veer Towers $550,000; The Martin $520,000; Trump International $300,425; Palms Place $207,000.
- Only Waldorf Astoria, Veer and Sky Las Vegas have Las Vegas Boulevard addresses on the Strip.
- Condo-hotels (Trump International, Palms Place) are generally ineligible for Fannie Mae financing.
